rightsHistoryPurpose: Official filiation, dated legal-entity rights and original-reference evidence for Chambertin-Clos de Bèze (#461). None establishes current farming.

namedPlots.coverageNote: The BIVB names Clos-de-Bèze as the climat for this appellation. CLOS DE BEZE is audited inside the unchanged INAO Chambertin-Clos de Bèze feature; small boundary contacts with other lieux-dits are retained as unresolved cadastral context. No duplicate selectable layer or producer holdings are published, and the whole-cru outline remains the fallback.
